old: In Iszony, László Németh—himself a practicing physician—uses past modals to probe the boundary between external duty and inner conscience. Even when an objective observer concludes 'ennél többet senki sem tehetett volna' (nobody could have done more), the protagonist's conscience still asks 'másképp kellett volna éreznem' (I should have felt differently).
new: The story in this lesson is an original story inspired by László Németh's novel Iszony (Németh was himself trained as a physician); it is not a scene from the book. It uses past modals to probe the boundary between external duty and inner conscience. Even when the doctor says 'ennél többet senki sem tehetett volna' (nobody could have done more), Nelli's conscience still asks what she should have done differently.
